about: SEA-SURFACE (2026-11-24): the open-ocean swimmers that cruise at the very top of the water, and only those whose own stored text says so (production species_field_guide, read-only, quoted exactly). Each row: the share of its time it spends up there, how deep its back rides while it does (m under the surface: shallow enough that its wingtips break the water as it swims), and the deciding quote and its field. The share is an estimate from the quote's frequency words ('much time'). A breach is NOT in here: the Giant Oceanic Manta Ray's stored text (spotlight, facts, traits, habitat, story) never says it leaves the water, so it has no row in water-leaps.json.

quote: It spends much time near the surface but has been recorded diving several hundred metres.
